# Shyam Jayachandran — nayyarsan.com

> AI & Enterprise Developer based in Los Angeles. Building AI-powered tools and developer experiences.

## About

Shyam Jayachandran (nayyarsan) is an AI and enterprise software developer. He builds developer tooling, autonomous AI agents, and personal productivity systems. His work spans VS Code extensions, self-hosted AI infrastructure, multi-source data pipelines, and cross-platform mobile/web apps.

- Personal site: https://nayyarsan.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/nayyarsan
- Email: available on the about page

## Projects

### Public

- **reflexloop** — Self-refining AI agents for software development. Agents critique every session and improve their own prompts autonomously. [Python] https://github.com/nayyarsan/reflexloop

- **business-requirements-agent** — VS Code extension that generates Business Requirements Documents using the GitHub Copilot SDK. [TypeScript] https://github.com/nayyarsan/business-requirements-agent

- **mynewsletters** — Automated weekly AI digest. Fetches 35+ sources, ranks with GPT-4o-mini, summarises with Claude, delivers to Telegram. [Python] https://github.com/nayyarsan/mynewsletters

- **discoveryandresearch** — Weekly AI repo discovery engine. Scrapes 9 sources, filters by license/language/relevance, publishes a Repo Spotlight. [Python] https://github.com/nayyarsan/discoveryandresearch

- **MyBudgetApp** — Flutter + Firebase personal finance app for Android, Windows, and web. Track accounts, transfers, and goals. [Dart] https://github.com/nayyarsan/MyBudgetApp

- **sight-word-quest** — PWA game to help children learn sight words with gamified practice and a parent dashboard. [JavaScript] https://github.com/nayyarsan/sight-word-quest

### Private

- **md-export-pro** — VS Code extension for markdown preview and export to DOCX/HTML. Supports Mermaid diagrams and light/dark themes. [TypeScript]

- **jarvis-personal-agent** — Airgapped personal AI running Ollama on a Raspberry Pi 5. Context never leaves the local network. [Python]
